sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though Alsager (bottom, 4 points from 10) arrive in poor form with just one win all season and no victories in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth welcome Eccleshall at home, with both sides looking to maintain their challenge in the upper reaches despite recent wobbles—Bridgnorth have lost their last two while Eccleshall showed recent form with a win. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a Wednesday midweek fixture (7 October, 19:45) after an impressive run, while Brereton Social host the same Wednesfield side on Saturday, looking to turn around patchy form. Bilston Town entertain Foley Meir on Saturday, with both sides in mid-table seeking consistency. In-form Barnton head to Shawbury United, who are struggling with five consecutive defeats, while New Mills visit Market Drayton Town and Crewe face Allscott Heath at home. Bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social on Saturday. Cheadle Heath Nomads complete the fixture list away at Telford Town, with both sides battling near the lower end of the table.
